resources.string: ⚠️ Bot service unavailable — check the token and internet
⚠️ No messages found. Open Telegram, send any message to your bot, then tap “Find chat”.
Enter the token and find the chat
✅ Test: the app is connected to Telegram
Failed to send. Check the token/chat and your internet connection.
⚠️ SMS permission not granted — forwarding will not work
⚠️ Battery optimization is on — the app may be put to sleep

1. Create a bot via @BotFather and paste the token (saved automatically).
2. Open Telegram and send any message to your bot.
3. Tap “Find chat” — the app detects the chat automatically.
4. Grant the SMS permission and send a test.
5. Turn off battery optimization so the app does not go to sleep.
